children: said on Tuesday it had partnered with artificial intelligence company Mistral to develop AI models for oil and gas reservoir exploration and engineering.
The three-year joint programme represents an investment of more than €100 million ($115 million) to support geoscience expertise in developing exploration opportunities, TotalEnergies said.
